title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For White Tongue
intro: Herbal creams for White tongue are topical treatments made from natural herbs and plants, typically used to alleviate symptoms of oral thrush or leukoplakia, characterized by a white or yellowish coating on the tongue. Examples of herbal creams used to treat White tongue include coconut oil cream, which has antimicrobial properties; neem cream, which helps to reduce bacterial and fungal growth; licorice root cream, which has anti-inflammatory properties; and aloe vera cream, which soothes and calms the tongue. Additionally, other herbal creams such as turmeric, tea tree oil, and guggul are also used due to their antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to combat the infection and promote healing.
